```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Finite ι] {s : ι → Set α} (hs : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint s)) : (⋃ i, s i).encard = ∑ᶠ (i : ι), (s i).encard := by
  have h_finite : (⋃ i, s i).Finite := Set.finite_iUnion_iff.2 (hs, Finite.univ)
  rw [Set.encard_eq_card h_finite]
  rw [Finset.card_iUnion_eq_sum hs]
  rw [∑ᶠ_eq_sum]
  rfl
```
